Implicit characteristic differentiation proves the local acceleration transition. Reproduced symbolic identities and 1007 finite assertions are corroborative only; all essential infinite-time steps appear explicitly in RESULT.md.

value.rationale: The complete model-specific mean-square stability phase diagram of a published randomized multi-reflection method gives a practical sharp benchmark for coupling relaxation and momentum. The all-m all-r parity law resolves when more reflections actually enlarge the stable momentum range. The sharp local acceleration sign transition at alpha=1/2, independent of dimension/count, provides substantive parameter-design insight beyond an already known fixed-alpha special case. It sharpens source sufficient bounds and exhibits an open signed-mean/second-moment separation; no general theorem or cost-normalized speedup is claimed.
